facts.fact: 她隔两天才敢回家，对着房门先声夺人地骂老鼠。
facts.anchor: “The rat was HUGE!” I raise my voice, staring down my apartment door like it might jump out at me.

facts.fact: 她怪那只老鼠搅了她的好事。
facts.anchor: I might have even gotten laid if not for the fucking rat. But my bad luck strikes again.

facts.fact: 她想象老鼠把通心粉拖回巢穴，一阵恶寒。
facts.anchor: A vision of a rat dragging the mac and cheese to their den causes a shiver of unease to wrack through me.

facts.fact: 她从床上抓起紫色青蛙。
facts.anchor: I grab the purple frog off of it.

facts.fact: 她宣布这地方对她来说已经死了。
facts.anchor: This place is dead to me.

facts.fact: B.L.T. 邮件：地址在此、今晚必须、Cinnamon 在上次那家餐厅、找 Mr. Jack。
facts.anchor: Here is the address. It must be this evening. Cinnamon is at the restaurant we met at, just ask for Mr. Jack.

facts.fact: Olive 提醒她别接陌生人递的药，最近出了怪事。
facts.anchor: Just be careful, don’t accept any drugs from strangers. There’s been some weird shit going on.

facts.fact: Olive 说他们演出中途有人当场死了。
facts.anchor: “I know, but one can never be too careful. It’s been scary. Someone croaked halfway through our set.”
About how the fifty dollars will barely cover my gas.

facts.fact: 客户还是没说要做什么菜、有没有忌口。
facts.anchor: He still didn’t tell me what to cook either. Or if he has any allergies…
